spans.text: Outside Bohnsdorf.
...Bohnsdorf?
Yup.
...The next location is Bohnsdorf?
You didn't know?
The Commander seems a little surprised.
Of course I didn't know!
If I had known...
Machlian remembers what she went through in Bohnsdorf and bites her lip.
...Are they going to attack this place too, Robin?
I think so, if the U-Bahn station and quarantine wall are any indication.
Your memories are quite reliable.
Perosa, how are things at the quarantine wall?
The government officials who came have taken over. It'll be fine.
Good, then let's focus on what's ahead us.
Dandelion?
Their defenses are shockingly lax. I thought barging in would take some effort after what happened last time.
But now it looks like they've either given up or something has happened to them.
Don't tell me they're already...
Machlian clutches the Commander' sleeve anxiously as she waits for Dandelion to continue.
No, I don't think we're too late.
There are no signs of explosions in the village and I can detect many signs of human activity.
What are they plotting?
Commander, we should just skip this location and move on to the next one.
Don't forget, this is a Paradeus stronghold.
It'll be too late to regret our actions once we charge in there and get surrounded.
This place is a Paradeus stronghold? What nonsense are you talking about?!
I won't dignify that with a reply.
...The people here have just been deceived by Paradeus.
They probably don't even count as official members of Paradeus yet.
Machlian's visions are proof of that. If this place really gets attacked...
Then they've pretty much been cannon fodder for Paradeus from the beginning.
May I remind you that these cannon fodder gave us a really hard time when we last came here?
When they go mad, they're harder to handle than any other enemy.
It's true that going alone into enemy territory is very unwise. 45, you and Squad 404 stand by here and prepare to pick us up at any time.
Roger. I won't even charge you extra for it.
But where would they hide the bombs in such a large village?
The amount of explosives needed to destroy such a spread-out village would be even more ridiculous than what you'd need to bring down the quarantine wall.
Considering Elia is the key figurehead of Bohnsdorf...
If I had to do it, I'd start with her.
However, just to be on the safe side... Perosa, take Squad Griffin and look around in the village.
Understood.
Given their present state, we might not be noticed even if we walked in through the front door.
...In any case, let's be careful.
We're not welcome here.
Machlian, can you stay here with Squad Griffin?
...Why?
You...You're too recognizable. I'm worried that the villagers will go crazy if they see you.
Machlian clutches her sleeve. She hesitates briefly, then looks up and shakes her head.
...Please take me with you, Robin.
I won't cause you trouble...
And if some disaster is going to strike Bohnsdorf...
I don't want to stay here and do nothing.
Just to put this out there, but I'm opposed to this.
What do you think, Commander?
The Commander looks first at Machlian, then at the quiet village.
...Alright, but we have to be careful.
If it really comes to a fight, at least they won't go too overboard with you around.
Thank you, Robin.
